mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 100.5), manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) reflects strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly core CPI increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market mismatch where job growth fails to absorb new entrants, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
